beats.label: The trial
beats.text: **165** frail adults, average age **79.** Two walking groups, **16** weeks.
beats.note: Danilovich et al., PLOS One 2026 (cluster randomized trial)

beats.label: Group A: casual
beats.text: Their own **comfy** pace, under **60%** of max heart rate.

beats.label: Group B: brisk
beats.text: Aiming for about **70%** of max heart rate. Same 45 minutes, **3x** a week.

beats.label: The scoreboard
beats.text: Frailty eased in **70%** of brisk walkers vs **46%** of casual. Both groups **gained.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: **Supervised,** fairly small, with dropouts. If you're frail, build up **slowly** with your doctor.
Follow for one study a day, **minus** the **hype.**
